rows.commentary: 0.1: Gerald Coetzee hits the deck hard on a back-of-a-length line, forcing Mitchell Marsh to tuck his bat behind the ball and smother the delivery into the pitch.
0.2: Gerald Coetzee finds a hint of away movement, drawing Mitchell Marsh back to defend a probing length delivery just outside the off-stump.
0.3: Gerald Coetzee bowls to Mitchell Marsh, a clean delivery passes untouched.
0.4: Gerald Coetzee hits a back of a length spot on off stump, forcing Mitchell Marsh to get squarely behind the line for a solid defensive block.
0.5: Mitchell Marsh tries to flick a full delivery angling into his pads, but he mistimes the shot and is promptly sent back by his partner after contemplating a risky single.
0.6: Gerald Coetzee concludes the over with a dot ball to Mitchell Marsh.
1.1: Lizaad Williams strays onto the pads and Travis Head expertly flicks it away to the backward square leg fence for four.
1.2: Lizaad Williams hits the length and Travis Head nudges it down to square third man to pick up a single.
1.3: Lizaad Williams hits the deck hard, the ball searing back off the surface to catch Mitchell Marsh flush on the mid-riff.
1.4: Mitchell Marsh shoulders arms as Lizaad Williams hits a probing length and finds some away movement.
1.5: Mitchell Marsh works this delivery firmly through the line, sending the ball racing away to the deep square leg fence for four.
1.6: Lizaad Williams angles the ball in from a length, and Mitchell Marsh guides it toward wide mid-on to collect a single.
2.1: Gerald Coetzee strays onto the pads and Mitchell Marsh expertly deflects it past the keeper to the fine leg fence for four.
2.2: Mitchell Marsh camps on his back foot to punish a short delivery from Gerald Coetzee, drilling it between mid-wicket and long-on for four.
2.3: Gerald Coetzee is dispatched over the ropes as Mitchell Marsh clears the boundary at deep mid-wicket with a massive six.
2.4: Gerald Coetzee angles the ball into Mitchell Marsh, who punches it firmly through the cover region to pick up a sharp pair of runs.
2.5: Mitchell Marsh guides a delivery from Gerald Coetzee down to third man for a comfortable single.
2.6: Gerald Coetzee digs this in outside off, but Travis Head slaps it firmly toward cover where a brilliant diving stop denies the boundary.
3.1: Lizaad Williams angles one into the pads that kicks up with unexpected lift, leaving Travis Head to miss his attempt at a clip through the leg side.
3.2: Lizaad Williams pulls his length back slightly, inducing a mistimed cut from Travis Head straight to the covers.
3.3: Travis Head survives a scare as an inside edge off Lizaad Williams’ short delivery narrowly misses the stumps and trickles to short fine leg for a single.
3.4: Lizaad Williams delivers to Mitchell Marsh, who keeps it out for no run.
3.5: Lizaad Williams finds sharp inward movement that beats Mitchell Marsh’s bat and thuds firmly into the thigh pad.
3.6: Mitchell Marsh shows excellent composure, getting his body squarely behind the line of the delivery to block Lizaad Williams with a watchful defense.
4.1: Gerald Coetzee hits a back of a length delivery angling away from the left-hander, which Travis Head expertly guides toward the point fielder.
4.2: Gerald Coetzee tails the ball into the pads, leaving Travis Head to tuck it neatly toward square leg.
4.3: Travis Head reaches the pitch of the over-pitched scramble seam delivery and blazes it along the turf to long-on for four.
4.4: Gerald Coetzee attacks the pads, and after Travis Head fails to connect with the clip, the ball deflects for a leg bye.
4.5: Mitchell Marsh capitalizes on the width, rising to the bounce to slash a fierce boundary to deep backward point.
4.6: Mitchell Marsh drives with authority, sending the ball racing down the ground to the long-off fence for four.
5.1: Lizaad Williams targets the middle stump with a full delivery, and Travis Head crisply strokes it toward mid-on for a single.
5.2: Lizaad Williams strays too full and straight on the pads, gifting Mitchell Marsh an easy clip through the air to deep mid-wicket for four.
5.3: Mitchell Marsh brings up the Australian fifty by presenting the full face of the bat and lofting a pitched-up delivery from Lizaad Williams through the line to long-on for four.
5.4: Lizaad Williams finds his mark and denies Mitchell Marsh any room for a scoring shot.
5.5: Lizaad Williams pulls the length back and probes the off-stump channel, drawing a controlled tap from Mitchell Marsh toward the waiting hands at short third.
5.6: Lizaad Williams drifts one full onto the pads, and Mitchell Marsh misses the flick as the ball pinballs off his leg to square leg for a single.
6.1: Corbin Bosch clocks 140ks, angling in from wide of the crease as Mitchell Marsh deftly works the delivery toward backward square leg for a run.
6.2: Corbin Bosch hammers the length to Travis Head, who finds no way through.
6.3: Travis Head retreats to the back foot to punch the length ball from Corbin Bosch, only to find the fielder stationed at covers.
6.4: Travis Head finds the gap, carving Corbin Bosch away to the deep backward point boundary for four runs.
6.5: Corbin Bosch hits a back-of-a-length line angling across the deck, forcing Travis Head to push firmly into the covers for no run.
6.6: Corbin Bosch slides a full delivery into the channel, but Head’s hard-handed drive to mid-off lacks the timing to beat the fielder.
7.1: Lizaad Williams digs this one in short and forces it back sharply off the deck, thudding into Mitchell Marsh’s midriff for no run.
7.2: Lizaad Williams oversteps as Mitchell Marsh punches the back-of-a-length delivery outside off to the left of the bowler, gifting a free hit to the batter.
7.2: Mitchell Marsh clears the front leg and dispatches Lizaad Williams over the long-on fence for a towering six.
7.3: Mitchell Marsh guides the ball fine, beating the fielder to the boundary rope at fine leg for four runs off Lizaad Williams.
7.4: Lizaad Williams hits the deck hard, pinning Mitchell Marsh down with a delivery that finds no gap.
7.5: Mitchell Marsh defends solidly as Lizaad Williams probes the corridor outside the off stump once more.

7.6: Mitchell Marsh reaches his 24th ODI half-century in streaky fashion, skewing a slower delivery from Lizaad Williams high into the air toward deep extra cover where it falls safely to net him two runs.
8.1: Corbin Bosch drifts wide, and Travis Head punishes the delivery by carving it through the line for four runs to deep extra cover.
8.2: Corbin Bosch drags a length delivery outside the off stump, tempting Travis Head into a wild, unsuccessful heave.
8.3: Travis Head connects cleanly, driving Corbin Bosch through the line to find the rope at deep extra cover.
8.4: Corbin Bosch rattles the stumps to dismantle Travis Head, who departs for 24 off 20 balls after striking five boundaries.
8.5: Corbin Bosch lures Cooper Connolly into a wide drive, the outside edge racing down to third man for a single with no slip in place.
8.6: Corbin Bosch bangs the final ball of the over in to Mitchell Marsh, who offers no stroke.
9.1: Bjorn Fortuin darts a flat, rapid delivery into the surface, forcing Cooper Connolly to punch the ball firmly toward the covers for no run.
9.2: Bjorn Fortuin drifts this one onto the pads, allowing Cooper Connolly to tuck it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
9.3: Bjorn Fortuin drifts this length delivery into the pads and Mitchell Marsh nudges it into the mid-wicket pocket for a single.
9.4: Bjorn Fortuin fires a flatter delivery onto middle stump, which Cooper Connolly blocks firmly back down the pitch.
9.5: Bjorn Fortuin delivers a sharp ball to Cooper Connolly, but the batsman lets it slip past for a dot.
9.6: Bjorn Fortuin lures Cooper Connolly into a lofted drive wide of off-stump, but Breetzke lets a golden opportunity slip through his palms at point.
10.1: Corbin Bosch attacks with a full delivery pushed across the line, drawing an outside edge from Cooper Connolly that skids away toward third man.
10.2: Corbin Bosch finds his length and Mitchell Marsh nudges the ball firmly toward mid-off to scamper through for a single.
10.3: Corbin Bosch serves a full, scramble-seam delivery that Cooper Connolly meets with a balanced stroke, threading the ball along the turf to deep extra cover for four.
10.4: Corbin Bosch pitches this one on a length, angling inward to find Cooper Connolly, who simply nudges the ball toward mid-on for no run.
10.5: Corbin Bosch delivers to Cooper Connolly, who eases the ball toward mid-off to collect a single.
10.6: Corbin Bosch digs the ball in short, cramping Mitchell Marsh for room as he punches the delivery straight to mid-off.
11.1: Bjorn Fortuin drifts this one up with a hint of turn, inviting Cooper Connolly to push it firmly back down the pitch.
11.2: Bjorn Fortuin hits his mark again, leaving Cooper Connolly with no room to maneuver.
11.3: Bjorn Fortuin induces a dangerous chip back toward his own follow-through as Cooper Connolly struggles to handle the extra bounce and flight.
11.4: The ball grips and turns sharply into the pads, allowing Cooper Connolly to nudge it away toward square-leg.
11.5: Cooper Connolly works the delivery into the leg side to rotate the strike with a single to square leg.
11.6: Bjorn Fortuin darts this flatter and shorter delivery outside off, prompting Mitchell Marsh to arch his back and punch the ball firmly toward sweeper cover for a single.
12.1: Mokoena drops short and wide, prompting Marsh to lash at the ball on the up, only for Maharaj to produce a sharp stop at point.
12.2: Marsh reaches for the full delivery outside off stump and carves a drive out to the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
12.3: Nqobani Mokoena hits the back of a length, angling across middle and leg, as Cooper Connolly gets firmly behind the line to dead-bat the delivery.
12.4: Nqobani Mokoena steams in once more to Cooper Connolly, who again finds no room to score.
12.5: Nqobani Mokoena drops short, and Cooper Connolly works it off his pads, capitalising on a clumsy fumble at deep mid-wicket that allows the single to slip through the fielder's legs.
12.6: Nqobani Mokoena drags the length back, inviting Mitchell Marsh to tap the ball into the covers for a sharp, well-judged single.
13.1: Bjorn Fortuin traps Mitchell Marsh plumb in front to end a sparkling 56-run knock.
13.2: Bjorn Fortuin drifts the ball into the pads, allowing Oliver Peake to work it neatly toward the mid-wicket region for a single.
13.3: Bjorn Fortuin delivers and Cooper Connolly clips the ball away into the deep square leg area to rotate the strike.
13.4: Bjorn Fortuin tosses it wide of off stump and Oliver Peake steers the delivery toward the off-side for no run.
13.5: Oliver Peake rocks back to pull a short ball from Bjorn Fortuin into the air toward backward square leg and scrambles through for a sharp pair of runs.
13.6: Bjorn Fortuin sends a powerful ball to Oliver Peake, who smashes it to third man for a four.
14.1: Nqobani Mokoena bowls to Cooper Connolly, no runs.
14.2: Nqobani Mokoena drops one slightly shorter on middle, but Cooper Connolly’s straight drive hammers directly into the stumps at the non-striker's end.
14.3: Cooper Connolly reads the length early and executes a clinical short-arm jab to the backward square leg fence for four.
14.4: Nqobani Mokoena angles one across and Cooper Connolly calmly steers it toward mid-off.
14.5: Nqobani Mokoena bowls to Cooper Connolly, who finds no run on this delivery.
14.6: Nqobani Mokoena strays onto the pads, and Cooper Connolly clips the delivery neatly toward backward square leg for a single.
15.1: Bjorn Fortuin drops it short and finds turn, but Cooper Connolly punches it firmly down to long-on for a single.
15.2: Oliver Peake capitalizes on the short length from Bjorn Fortuin, pulling the delivery away to backward square leg for one.
15.3: Bjorn Fortuin goes a touch shorter and Cooper Connolly punches the ball out to sweeper cover to rotate the strike.
15.4: Bjorn Fortuin extracts turn with a shorter delivery, forcing Oliver Peake to retreat and defend firmly.
15.5: Bjorn Fortuin zips one through flatter and quicker, and Oliver Peake slices it away to sweeper cover for a single.
15.6: Cooper Connolly works the ball toward fine leg and scampers back for a pair.
16.1: Nqobani Mokoena hits the back of a length on the pads, allowing Oliver Peake to tuck the ball away toward deep square leg for a single.
16.2: Nqobani Mokoena rolls his fingers over a fuller delivery, but Cooper Connolly pushes it safely to the right of the bowler.
16.3: Nqobani Mokoena angles the ball in from round the wicket, met by a watchful defensive prod from Cooper Connolly.
16.4: Nqobani Mokoena serves up a full delivery that tails into the pads, and Cooper Connolly clips it toward backward square leg to rotate the strike.
16.5: Nqobani Mokoena finds a probing length, inducing a squared-up Oliver Peake to edge the late-moving delivery down to third man for a single.
16.6: Nqobani Mokoena completes the over as Cooper Connolly clips the final ball toward the cover fielder to rotate the strike.
16.6: Nqobani Mokoena oversteps as he delivers a back-of-a-length ball that Cooper Connolly punches to wide mid-off for a single, signaling a free hit.
16.6: Nqobani Mokoena finds his mark and dots down to Oliver Peake to close out the over.
17.1: Gerald Coetzee strikes in his comeback spell, angling a searing cross-seam yorker from round the wicket that sneaks beneath Cooper Connolly’s late defensive push to shatter the stumps.
17.2: Gerald Coetzee hits a testing good length around off-stump as Alex Carey rocks onto the back foot to nudge the ball toward cover.
17.3: Gerald Coetzee digs one in short outside the off stump, forcing Alex Carey to hop and guide the ball away toward backward point for no run.
17.4: Alex Carey nudges this delivery out to the sweeper cover fielder to rotate the strike with a single.
17.5: Gerald Coetzee thunders in at 147.9ks, angling the ball toward off-stump for Oliver Peake to nudge away for a single.
17.6: Gerald Coetzee serves it up to Carey, who deftly directs the ball down to backward square leg to rotate the strike.
18.1: Nqobani Mokoena attacks the pads with a full delivery, and after Alex Carey misses his flick, the ball deflects off his pad to earn a leg-bye.
18.2: Oliver Peake guides the ball down to deep backward point to pick up a single.
18.3: Nqobani Mokoena drifts this delivery well outside the off-stump, leaving the umpire’s arms outstretched to signal a wide.
18.3: Nqobani Mokoena persists with a leg-stump line, allowing Carey to tuck the ball into the vacant square leg region for an easy run.
18.4: Nqobani Mokoena digs this one in short with extra effort, but the ball sails well over Oliver Peake's head to be signaled a wide for height.
18.4: Oliver Peake skies this delivery, watching anxiously as the ball lands just inches in front of the fielder charging in from back point.
18.5: Oliver Peake finds the gap, steering Nqobani Mokoena away to the fine leg fence for four.
18.5: Nqobani Mokoena drifts onto the pads, and the ball deflects off Oliver Peake’s leg to race away toward the fine leg boundary.
18.6: Nqobani Mokoena finds a good length on middle stump, and Oliver Peake dead-bats the ball firmly back to the bowler.
19.1: Gerald Coetzee charges in to deliver a dot ball to Carey.
19.2: Gerald Coetzee hunts the channel again, drawing a desperate, empty swing from Carey as the ball zips past the outside edge.
19.3: Gerald Coetzee keeps the pressure mounting on Carey with another dot ball.
19.4: Gerald Coetzee angles the delivery into the pads, allowing Carey to nudge it square of the wicket for a single.
19.5: Gerald Coetzee ramps up the pace with a sharp bouncer that forces Oliver Peake to duck for safety.
19.6: Oliver Peake is completely bamboozled by the line, pushing his bat away from his body with no footwork to be soundly beaten on the outside edge by Gerald Coetzee.
20.1: Aiden Markram to Carey, no run, Alex Carey is halfway down the pitch and is in trouble. A better throw from the covers fielder would have got him in trouble.
20.2: Aiden Markram finds turn away from the left-hander, allowing Alex Carey to push the ball comfortably to sweeper cover for a single.
20.3: Aiden Markram to Oliver Peake, 1 run, to sweeper cover.
20.4: Aiden Markram hits the spot as Alex Carey defends the delivery firmly with no room for a run.
20.5: Alex Carey clips the ball toward long-on and scampers through for a comfortable single off the bowling of Aiden Markram.
20.6: Oliver Peake strides forward against Aiden Markram, dead-batting the ball into the on-side for no run.
21.1: Gerald Coetzee provides width, and Alex Carey pounces to carve the ball away for four.
21.2: Gerald Coetzee keeps it tight as Alex Carey nudges the delivery toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
21.3: Gerald Coetzee drifts down the leg side, conceding a wide to Oliver Peake.
21.3: Gerald Coetzee digs a sharp bouncer in that sails well over Oliver Peake, who wisely drops his shoulders to let it pass.
21.4: Gerald Coetzee attacks the stumps again but Oliver Peake remains unmoved in his crease.
21.5: Gerald Coetzee strays down the leg side and the umpire signals a wide.
21.5: Gerald Coetzee hits a good length outside the off-stump, allowing Oliver Peake to tap it away into the off-side for a single.
21.6: Alex Carey watches a good length delivery drift past his off-stump and calmly shoulders arms to close the over.
22.1: Aiden Markram tosses this one up outside off, inviting the block from Oliver Peake who steers it toward cover.
22.2: Oliver Peake advances down the pitch to meet the flight, smothering the ball firmly into the cover region.
22.3: Playing off the back foot, Oliver Peake defends the delivery straight back to the waiting hands of Aiden Markram.
22.4: Oliver Peake drops low to sweep a flatter delivery off his pads, sending the ball scurrying away to deep square leg for two runs.
22.5: Aiden Markram drifts a loopy delivery onto middle stump, drawing Oliver Peake down the track to smother the ball back into the pitch.
22.6: Aiden Markram fires a flatter ball that skids through, leaving Oliver Peake clutching at air as he attempts a mistimed cut shot.
23.1: Gerald Coetzee hammers a good length ball into the middle stump, which Carey calmly nudges toward the off-side.
23.2: Carey guides this latest delivery from Gerald Coetzee out to sweeper cover to rotate the strike with a single.
23.3: Gerald Coetzee thunders in at 147.2 clicks, angling a shortish delivery across the left-hander that Oliver Peake hops to meet with a firm defensive block toward cover.
23.4: Gerald Coetzee strays slightly, and Oliver Peake carves the delivery away to deep backward point for a crisp boundary.
23.5: Gerald Coetzee pushes the delivery far outside the line, forcing the umpire to signal a wide to Oliver Peake.
23.5: Gerald Coetzee clocks 144.7ks with a sharp bouncer that forces Oliver Peake to duck beneath the trajectory.
23.6: Oliver Peake guides the final delivery of the over down to deep backward point for a boundary.
24.1: Aiden Markram drifts one into the pads but Carey defends solidly back toward the bowler.
24.2: Markram maintains his line and length, forcing Carey to watch the ball safely through to the keeper.
24.3: Aiden Markram delivers to Carey, who defends the ball firmly.
24.4: Carey nudges the ball into the on-side to scamper through for a comfortable single.
24.5: Oliver Peake shifts to the back foot to negotiate the length and defends the ball solidly.
24.6: Oliver Peake rocks back to connect cleanly, punching the ball down toward long-on to pick up a single.
25.1: Tristan Stubbs pushes the ball fuller, inviting Oliver Peake to drive it crisply along the turf to long-off for one.
25.2: Carey works the ball toward the deep, finding the fielder at sweeper cover for a comfortable single.
25.3: Tristan Stubbs keeps his line tight, denying Oliver Peake any room to maneuver as the ball dots down for no run.
25.4: Tristan Stubbs forces the issue, but Oliver Peake sees his attempted on-side drive clipped by an inside edge that ricochets off his pads and dies on the off-side.
25.5: Oliver Peake dances down the pitch to meet the half-volley, stroking it cleanly down the ground for a single to long-on.
25.6: Tristan Stubbs darts one in flat onto the pads, allowing Carey to comfortably nudge the ball toward mid-wicket for no gain.
26.1: Aiden Markram begins his spell as Oliver Peake clips the ball away to long-on for a brisk single.
26.2: Aiden Markram bowls to Alex Carey, who cuts a tad-short drive to sweeper cover for a single.
26.3: Aiden Markram bowls to Oliver Peake, who taps a wide-of-cover shot for another single.
26.4: Aiden Markram drifts one into Carey, who clips it away for a pair as de Zorzi sprints to his right and slides low at sweeper cover to deny the boundary.
26.5: Aiden Markram bowls to Alex Carey, who sends a single to sweeper cover.
26.6: Aiden Markram bowls to Oliver Peake, who sends a single to sweeper cover.
27.1: Tristan Stubbs drifts one into the slot and Oliver Peake pushes it for a single, the ball dipping dangerously close to the waiting fielder.
27.2: Tristan Stubbs hits the deck, and Carey offers no shot to the delivery.
27.3: Carey defends solidly as Tristan Stubbs continues his spell.
27.4: Tristan Stubbs finds his length again, and Carey turns this one away without finding a gap.
27.5: Carey clears the front leg and dispatches Tristan Stubbs high over the deep mid-wicket boundary for six.
27.6: Tristan Stubbs delivers, and Alex Carey meets the ball firmly behind the line to block it.
28.1: Aiden Markram tosses this one up on middle stump, inviting Oliver Peake to defend comfortably off the back foot.
28.2: Aiden Markram hits the target again, but Oliver Peake holds his ground to keep the delivery scoreless.
28.3: Oliver Peake nudges this Aiden Markram delivery down to long-off to pick up a single.
28.4: Aiden Markram persists with the same probing line, inviting Carey to shuffle across the crease and punch a single down to long-on.
28.5: Oliver Peake pounces on the width, rocking back to punish the short delivery with a clean strike for six.
28.6: Aiden Markram drags it short and wide, allowing Oliver Peake to open the face and steer a single down to deep point.
29.1: Corbin Bosch searches for fullness outside off stump, neatly met and punched by Oliver Peake toward sweeper cover.
29.2: Corbin Bosch probes a good length around off, forcing Alex Carey to dead-bat the delivery toward mid-off.
29.3: An inside edge clips the pads before Carey and Peake scramble for a sharp single, safely beating Bosch’s desperate attempt at a direct hit.
29.4: Corbin Bosch persists with the short ball as Oliver Peake finds himself visibly unsettled by the rising delivery.
29.5: Oliver Peake swivels on a short ball from Corbin Bosch, guiding it past the outstretched fielder at fine leg for a boundary.
29.6: Corbin Bosch strays slightly, allowing Oliver Peake to carve the ball into the deep backward point region for a comfortable pair of runs.
30.1: Bjorn Fortuin drifts this full delivery onto middle stump, allowing Carey to sweep firmly along the carpet toward deep square leg for a single.
30.2: Bjorn Fortuin drops this one short and into the body, inviting Oliver Peake to swivel and pull the ball down to deep square leg for one.
30.3: Alex Carey shuffles across his stumps to sweep the ball fine, but he picks out the fielder stationed at short fine leg perfectly.
30.4: Bjorn Fortuin fires a flatter delivery wide of the off stump, which Carey punches sharply but straight into the hands of the cover fielder.
30.5: Alex Carey presses forward with soft hands to turn the ball away, finding only the mid-wicket fielder for no gain.
30.6: Bjorn Fortuin completes the over with a dot ball as Carey finds no way through.
31.1: Corbin Bosch draws the edge from Oliver Peake, and Bjorn Fortuin safely clutches the catch to end a spirited 48-run knock.
31.2: Corbin Bosch hits the deck hard and Matt Renshaw defends solidly back down the pitch.
31.3: Corbin Bosch hits the deck hard and finds the line, forcing Matt Renshaw to defend solidly into the turf for no run.
31.4: Corbin Bosch angles this one into the pads, clipping off Matt Renshaw’s thigh to scamper away for a leg bye toward square leg.
31.5: Corbin Bosch hits the deck hard, pinning Carey into a defensive block with no room for a run.
31.6: Bosch maintains the pressure, angling another delivery across Carey who turns it into the turf for no gain.
32.1: Matt Renshaw dances down the pitch and drives Bjorn Fortuin firmly down to long-on for a single.
32.2: Carey meets the delivery with a dead bat, blocking it securely into the on-side.
32.3: Alex Carey angles the blade late to steer a sharp cut past point for a comfortable run.
32.4: Matt Renshaw leans forward and nudges the ball firmly toward the on-side for no gain.
32.5: Bjorn Fortuin hits his length and Matt Renshaw defends the delivery firmly back toward the bowler.
32.6: Bjorn Fortuin bowls a flat delivery that skids across Matt Renshaw, who misjudges the line and is beaten on the outside edge for no run.
33.1: Corbin Bosch to Carey, no run, a very full delivery on the leg stump as Alex Carey mistimes the push to mid‑on.
33.2: Corbin Bosch to Carey, FOUR, a delivery to deep extra cover that clears the boundary.
33.3: Corbin Bosch delivers a 141.8 ks ball on middle and leg, Carey defends back to the bowler.
33.4: Corbin Bosch bowls a good‑length delivery on the middle, Carey defends to the on‑side.
33.5: Corbin Bosch bowls, Carey nudges a single to backward square leg.
33.6: Corbin Bosch delivers a sharp ball to Matt Renshaw, who slices it to the right of the wicket, leaving the channel around off‑stump empty for a dot.
34.1: Bjorn Fortuin delivers a tossed-up ball outside off to Alex Carey, who lofts it over the infield at cover for two runs.
34.2: Bjorn Fortuin bowls to Carey, who nudges the ball to mid-on for a single.
34.3: Bjorn Fortuin to Matt Renshaw, SIX, tossed up delivery around off.
34.4: Bjorn Fortuin bowls to Matt Renshaw, who nudges a single, flatter through the air on middle and leg, clipped towards mid-wicket.
34.5: Bjorn Fortuin delivers to Alex Carey, who bunts a single towards long‑on, flatter through the air.
34.6: Bjorn Fortuin again bowls to Matt Renshaw, who drifts a single on the pads, clipped through mid‑wicket.
35.1: Nqobani Mokoena delivers a back‑of‑a‑length ball to Matt Renshaw, who clips it cleanly to the leg side for a single.
35.2: Nqobani Mokoena bowls a tad fuller at middle‑leg to Alex Carey, who flicks it towards mid‑wicket for no run.
35.3: Nqobani Mokoena bowls again to Alex Carey, who leaves it for a dot.
35.4: Nqobani Mokoena delivers a length ball to Alex Carey, who steers it to mid‑off for a single.
35.5: Nqobani Mokoena bowls to Matt Renshaw, who flicks a single over square leg as the bowler goes full.
35.6: Nqobani Mokoena bowls a back‑of‑a‑length to Alex Carey, who softly nudges it to the off‑side for no run.
36.1: Aiden Markram swings at Matt Renshaw's delivery, nudging it to a wide long‑off for a single.
36.2: Aiden Markram's shot drifts onto the pads, Alex Carey nudges it toward mid‑wicket for no run.
36.3: Aiden Markram curls a fraction short around off, Alex Carey punches it to mid‑off for a single.
36.4: Aiden Markram tosses the ball up around off, Matt Renshaw drives it back to the bowler for no run.
36.5: Aiden Markram’s delivery turns sharply as the bowler goes full, Matt Renshaw drops to his knee, attempts a sweep and misses.

36.6: Aiden Markram to Matt Renshaw, FOUR, has been a good over, until that last ball. This was short and wide outside off, Matt Renshaw throws the kitchen sink at it, smashing it through cover for a boundary to end the over

37.1: Nqobani Mokoena to Carey, FOUR, back-to-back boundaries. This was pitched up by the bowler outside off, Alex Carey stays put and thumps it over wide mid-off. Sublime timing as this almost went the distance
37.2: Nqobani Mokoena to Carey, no run
37.3: Nqobani Mokoena delivers a back‑of‑a‑length outside‑off to Alex Carey, who steers it to cover‑point where a fielder slides in and snatches it cleanly.
37.4: Nqobani Mokoena bowls a good‑length outside‑off to Matt Renshaw, who defends it into the off‑side without conceding a run.
37.5: Nqobani Mokoena launches a crisp drive to Matt Renshaw, the ball skims short at the middle and leg, slipping through to square‑leg for a tidy single
37.6: Nqobani Mokoena to Carey, 1 run, fraction short at the hips, clipped through backward square leg with a closed bat face.
38.1: Aiden Markram to Carey, no run, tossed up delivery around off, pushed back to the bowler
38.2: Aiden Markram to Carey, 2 runs, goes down on his knee and reverse sweeps this over point for a brace
38.3: Aiden Markram to Carey, no run, pushed down the pitch by Alex Carey
38.4: Aiden Markram delivers to Alex Carey, who steers it through cover for a single.
38.5: Aiden Markram bowls a wide to Matt Renshaw; the batsman attempts a sweep down the leg side and misses.
38.5: Aiden Markram to Matt Renshaw, who pushes the ball toward long‑on for a single.
